insightsEmptyText: No suggestions right now. The more items you add, the better the tips get.
insightsDisclaimer: Tips are based on fixed rules and your data; savings are rough estimates. Not tax, legal or investment advice.
insightDeficitText: You are {amount} short per month. Check wishes and subscriptions first or temporarily lower savings.
insightNeedsText: Needs take {percent} % instead of {target} % (≈ {amount} per month over). The biggest levers are usually housing, transport and insurance.
insightSavingsText: You save {percent} % instead of {target} %. You need {amount} more per month — easiest via a standing order on payday.
insightFlaggedText: {count, plural, =1{You entered a possible saving for one item.} other{You entered possible savings for {count} items.}} Set a date to cancel or switch.
insightDuplicateText: {count} contracts costing {amount} per month together. A partner or family plan is often cheaper.
insightOverlapText: {count} subscriptions of the same kind run in parallel. Rotating saves money: keep only one active and switch monthly.
insightInsuranceText: {count, plural, =1{One policy is} other{{count} policies are}} paid in instalments. Many insurers charge a few percent extra for that — ask for annual payment.
insightZeroText: {count, plural, =1{One item has} other{{count} items have}} 0 €. Is the amount missing, or can the contract go?
insightInterestText: At least one savings account has no or less than {rate} % interest. Comparing savings accounts pays off with regular deposits.
insightEmergencyText: Three months of needs are recommended, about {amount}. Your savings accounts hold {percent} % of that.
insightEmergencyUnknown: Three months of needs are recommended, about {amount}. Enter balances for your savings accounts to track it.
insightBiggestWantText: It takes {percent} % of your net income — {amount} per year. Even a small cut has a big effect here.
insightMissingAccountText: {count, plural, =1{One item has} other{{count} items have}} no account. With an account, the split view shows exact standing orders.
insightReserveText: Move {amount} per month to a separate sub-account so annual fees never leave a hole.
